corrigendum_rationale.gate_a_defect: P8 Gate A targeted modern_raw/M_LC_lowcontrast_raw (the intentional negative-control / broken-resize condition produced by keras UpSampling2D with half-pixel-centre semantics) as a positive acceptance requirement. A source-faithful production implementation using legacy-compatible resize (tf.raw_ops.ResizeBilinear, align_corners=False, half_pixel_centers=False) is required to differ from M_LC. Gate A has been demoted to Diag-1 and the positive acceptance criterion is replaced with the pre-registered functional-parity thresholds against the legacy reference (identical to P8 Gate B).
corrigendum_rationale.gate_c_defect: P8 Gate C enforced same_dtype between the native float32 production classification output and a float64 reference produced by an explicit cast in golden/modern_causality.py (lines 78 and 254). The float64 dtype is a serialization convention in the evidence-generation script, not a property of the model or a scientific requirement. Gate C has been demoted to Diag-2 with no dtype requirement. The classification acceptance criterion is replaced by the pre-registered cli_abs_max tolerance (identical to P8 Gate D).
corrigendum_rationale.gate_selection_basis: The corrected acceptance gates (Gate 1 = P8 Gate B logic, Gate 2 = P8 Gate D logic) were selected because they test source-faithful parity with the legacy reference. They were not selected because their P8 outcomes were already known.
corrigendum_rationale.binding_invariant: The production UMSI++ implementation must remain source-faithful. No architecture, weights, preprocessing, resize semantics or native outputs were modified to satisfy a validation gate.

gate_1.name: production_raw_saliency_vs_legacy_raw_saliency
gate_1.corrigendum_note: Replaces P8 Gate A as the saliency acceptance gate. Uses the same postprocess and pre-registered thresholds as P8 Gate B.

resize_details.note: Both production and reference are already 512x512; identical_resize is an identity operation

gate_2.name: production_classification_vs_legacy_classification
gate_2.corrigendum_note: Replaces P8 Gate C as the classification acceptance gate. Identical calculation to P8 Gate D. No dtype requirement; both arrays compared in float64.
gate_2.dtype_note: Native dtypes are recorded but not required to match. The production model natively outputs float32; the legacy reference was stored as float64 as a serialization convention in the evidence-generation script.

max_abs_diff_float64.threshold_label: cli_abs_max — Step 2B classification-output tolerance; NOT a Stage-2 score or downstream threshold

diag_1.name: saliency_negative_control_m_lc
diag_1.corrigendum_note: Demoted from P8 Gate A. Records how production saliency compares to the M_LC reference (the intentional broken-resize condition). Expected outcome: production does NOT satisfy positive-parity thresholds against M_LC. An unexpected M_LC pass is BLOCKING and produces INCONCLUSIVE_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.

unexpected_pass_alarm.condition: pearson >= pearson_min AND spearman >= spearman_min AND windowed_ssim >= ssim_min
unexpected_pass_alarm.rationale: If production matches M_LC thresholds, it would indicate the production model may be using modern (broken) resize semantics despite the LegacyBilinearUpSampling2D implementation. This contradicts the source-faithful claim and requires investigation.

unevaluable_state_handling.condition: diag_1 result is anything other than a successfully evaluated, discriminative negative control (passed=true, reason=null, observed.alarm=false) or the specific unexpected_pass_alarm state above. Includes: constant-map abort, compute error, evaluator exception, invalid evaluator return, or a missing/malformed alarm field.
unevaluable_state_handling.rationale: A negative control that cannot be evaluated to a discriminative result provides no evidence that production differs from the M_LC broken-resize condition. It must never be treated as equivalent to a discriminative pass and must never permit a PASS conclusion.

diag_2.name: classification_m_lc_proximity_diagnostic
diag_2.corrigendum_note: Demoted from P8 Gate C. Records numerical proximity of production classification to M_LC classification. No dtype check. No pass/fail verdict. Records cross-environment float32-to-float64 drift.

frozen_thresholds.note: All numeric thresholds are inherited unchanged from the P8 contract and the historical resize-causality pre-registration. No threshold was modified as a result of observing P8 outcomes.

verdict_logic.pass_condition: identity_check_passes (current production source SHA matches p8_production_source_sha256 AND current UMSI weights SHA matches weights_sha256) AND diag_1_successfully_evaluated_and_discriminative (passed=true, reason=null, observed.alarm=false) AND gate_1_passes AND gate_2_passes
verdict_logic.identity_check_priority_note: The production source SHA and weights SHA identity check is evaluated FIRST, before any gate or negative-control outcome. A mismatch on either always yields INVALID_INTEGRITY + BLOCKED, regardless of gate results. This makes a PASS + BLOCKED combination structurally impossible: norms release is only ever considered once the identity check has already passed, so PASS implies UNBLOCKED and UNBLOCKED implies PASS.

p8_to_p9_provenance_map.gate_1: preserves P8 Gate B acceptance semantics (production raw saliency vs legacy/source-faithful raw saliency reference)
p8_to_p9_provenance_map.diag_1: reclassified P8 Gate A comparison (production raw saliency vs M_LC/broken-resize reference; demoted to blocking negative-control diagnostic)
p8_to_p9_provenance_map.gate_2: preserves P8 Gate D acceptance semantics (production classification vs legacy classification reference)
p8_to_p9_provenance_map.diag_2: reclassified P8 Gate C comparison (production classification vs M_LC classification reference; demoted to record-only diagnostic, no dtype requirement)

saliency_norms_release.UNBLOCKED_if: conclusion == STEP_2B_P9_CORRIGENDUM_PASS (which, by construction, already requires current production source SHA to match p8_production_source_sha256 AND current UMSI weights SHA to match weights_sha256)
saliency_norms_release.BLOCKED_if: conclusion is FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, or INVALID. A source or weights SHA mismatch always yields INVALID (never a mismatched PASS).

verdict_logic.p10_conditions: A future P10 run (with inference and intermediate activation capture) becomes necessary only if: (1) production source changes since 38b75036..., (2) weights change, (3) a new fixture is added, or (4) runtime code-path proof is required for an external audit.

direct_runtime_activation_capture.thesis_sufficiency_assessment: The combination of (1) pinned and verified production source SHA, (2) static code-path trace confirming LegacyBilinearUpSampling2D uses tf.raw_ops.ResizeBilinear(align_corners=False, half_pixel_centers=False), (3) near-perfect functional parity with the legacy reference (Gate 1 Pearson > 0.999, Spearman > 0.999, SSIM > 0.999), and (4) M_LC negative-control discrimination (Diag-1 expected Pearson ~0.976), is sufficient for thesis-level source-faithful validation without direct activation capture. P10 with activation capture would upgrade this from NOT_PROVEN to PROVEN but is not required to unblock saliency norm computation.
